reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00404080 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/go/00404080-GOGfxGamma.cpp at sha256 c49d9c91775332312abdd897acef2f79ace0332231860a6b4003eb3f33c9ecc8 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t GOGfxGamma(long param_1, int32_t param_2, float param_3);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0, int32_t arg2, float arg3 @ 0xc)" at 0x00404080; radare2 recovers "fcn.00404080 (int32_t arg_24h_2, int32_t arg_24h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00404080 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame.
